title: Conjugate Boundary Conditions, Kaluza-Klein Fermions, and an Extended Seesaw Model
summary: In this paper, we discuss the conjugate boundary condition (CBC), which has recently been studied as a way of realizing a Majorana fermion within a compactified five-dimensional theory ($\mathcal M^4\otimes S^1/Z_2$). The Majorana fermion which plays a crucial role in the seesaw scenario arises as a zero mode (lowest mode) by imposing the CBC.
